lines.en: label yukispring1:
scene yukicheckup1
: Yuki! It’s your debatably closest friend and employer, Sara! Are you in there?
lines.zh: : Yuki！是你那个说不好算不算最亲近的朋友兼老板，Sara！你在里面吗？

lines.en: We finally make it to Yuki’s place and, after ascending what can only be referred to as “an annoying amount of stairs,” we make our presence known.
lines.zh: 我们终于到了 Yuki 家，爬完一段只能被称为「烦人级数量的楼梯」之后，我们宣告了自己的到来。

lines.en: Or at least we attempt to.
lines.zh: 至少我们尝试了。

lines.en: Honestly, I think I’d {i}prefer{/i} if she isn’t around right now as that would all but eliminate the possibility of us forcing our way in and finding something {i}no one{/i} wants to see.
lines.zh: 说实话，我倒是{i}希望{/i}她现在不在家，因为那样就基本排除了我们硬闯进去、撞见{i}谁都{/i}不想看的场面的可能。

lines.en: : Hellooooo? Yuki? Open up, please!
lines.zh: : 喂——有人吗？Yuki？开门，拜托！

lines.en: : Maybe she’s just...out with other friends?
lines.zh: : 也许她只是……跟别的朋友出去了？

lines.en: : What other friends? I’m pretty much the only one she’s got. That “debatable” part earlier was only there to stop her from feeling bad if she was listening.
lines.zh: : 什么别的朋友？我基本就是她唯一的朋友。刚才那个「说不好算不算」只是万一她在听，免得她难受。

lines.en: : Which I am starting to believe she is not.
lines.zh: : 而我开始觉得，她并没有在听。

lines.en: : Then...what if she got a new job? It’s not unheard of for people to just bail on workplaces once they find something else to do, right?
lines.zh: : 那……会不会是她找了份新工作？人们一找到别的事做就撂挑子走人，也不是没听说过，对吧？

lines.en: scene yukicheckup2
: Speaking from experience, huh?
lines.zh: : 这是经验之谈咯？

lines.en: : I think my situation might be a little different on account of all the sudden trauma. Also, what are you doing?
lines.zh: : 我觉得我的情况可能不太一样，毕竟我经受了那么多突如其来的创伤。还有，你在干什么？

lines.en: : Unlocking the door, duh. If she’s not going to answer, I’m going to let myself in.
lines.zh: : 开门啊，废话。她要是不应，那我就自己进去了。

lines.en: : Yuki gave you a key to her apartment?
lines.zh: : Yuki 给了你她公寓的钥匙？

lines.en: : Hm? Nope.
lines.zh: : 嗯？没有。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup3
: Skeleton key. I’ve had it for years.
lines.zh: : 万能钥匙。我都用好多年了。

lines.en: : You just...happen to have a key that unlocks all doors?
lines.zh: : 你就……碰巧有一把能开所有门的钥匙？

lines.en: scene yukicheckup4
: Not {i}all{/i} of them, technically. Most houses have fancy locks now, so stuff like this doesn’t work as well as it did when I was a teenager.
lines.zh: : 严格来说不是{i}所有{/i}。现在大多数房子都装了高级锁，所以这种东西不像我十几岁那会儿那么好使了。

lines.en: : With low-income apartments like this, though — all you really need to do is shove this bad boy inside, wiggle it around, and voila. Kind of like sex.
lines.zh: : 不过像这种低租金公寓——你只要把这玩意儿塞进去，左右拧几下，搞定。有点像做爱。

lines.en: : Sara.
lines.zh: : Sara。

lines.en: : Yes?
lines.zh: : 怎么？

lines.en: : {i}Why{/i} do you have that?
lines.zh: : 你{i}为什么{/i}会有那个？

lines.en: : Excellent question, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 好问题，老师。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup5
: Let’s go in.
lines.zh: : 我们进去吧。

lines.en: : What?...
: Yuki! Last chance!
lines.zh: : Yuki！最后的机会！

lines.en: scene black
: You have three seconds to respond before we enter the room!
lines.zh: : 给你三秒钟回应，不然我们就进屋了！

lines.en: : Are you really sure this is a good idea?...
lines.zh: : 你真的确定这是个好主意吗？……

lines.en: : You don’t want to turn around and just...try again tomorrow?
lines.zh: : 你就不想转身……明天再来一次？

lines.en: : Okay, Yuki! Time is up!
lines.zh: : 好了，Yuki！时间到！

lines.en: : Pardon the intrusion...
lines.zh: : 打扰了……

lines.en: scene yukicheckup6
: Ooooh boy...
lines.zh: : 噢，老天……
: Nm…………mngh…………

lines.en: : Well...she’s {i}breathing.{/i} That’s good at least.
lines.zh: : 嗯……她还在{i}呼吸{/i}。至少这点还好。

lines.en: Upon entering the apartment, the worst of our fears is dispelled. But that doesn’t make the sight before us any more pleasing to look at.
lines.zh: 进了公寓，我们最糟的恐惧被打消了。但这并没有让眼前的景象变得更好看一点。

lines.en: The scents of smoke and alcohol permeate the room, clinging to the walls and combining with the already unpleasant odor that’s been emanating from the carpet since she first moved in.
lines.zh: 烟味和酒味浸透了整个房间，黏在墙上，又和她搬进来那天起就一直从地毯里散发出来的那股难闻气味混在一起。

lines.en: : Is it...just beer? You don’t see anything else?
lines.zh: : 只有……啤酒吗？你没看到别的什么？

lines.en: : I see...water.
lines.zh: : 我看到了……水。

lines.en: : Oh, good. So she’s staying hydrated.
lines.zh: : 哦，那就好。看来她还记得补水。

lines.en: : I’m not really sure what else you-
lines.zh: : 我不太确定你还想找些——

lines.en: : {i}Drugs.{/i}
: Needles...Pipes...Small plastic baggies...You don’t see any of that, do you?
lines.zh: : 针头……管子……小小的塑料密封袋……这些你都没看到吧？

lines.en: : Yuki’s clean. And I’d prefer to keep giving her the benefit of the doubt.
lines.zh: : Yuki 是干净的。而且我更愿意继续先假定她无辜。

lines.en: : So would I, obviously. But addicts take advantage of that sort of thing, Sensei. You’ve gotta remember, I don’t exactly come from the happiest of households.
lines.zh: : 我当然也希望如此。但瘾君子就是会利用这种心理，老师。你得记住，我出身的家庭可算不上幸福。

lines.en: : Angh......mmmblff.......mmffngh....
lines.zh: : Angh…………mmmblff……………mmffngh……

lines.en: Despite the sounds that leak from her mouth — that bleed through her pillow and find their way to us, I take solace in the fact that she fell asleep face down and can’t choke to death on her vomit.
lines.zh: 尽管她的嘴里漏出各种声音——透过枕头渗出来、传到我们耳朵里，我还是能从一件事上得到安慰：她是趴着睡的，不会被自己的呕吐物呛死。

lines.en: But again, that is no {i}bandage.{/i} There’s a wound that’s opened up in me — and it’s spurting blood all over her carpet but refusing to mask those other scents.
lines.zh: 但话说回来，这也算不上{i}创可贴{/i}。我身上裂开了一道伤口——正把血喷得她地毯上到处都是，却怎么也盖不住其他那些气味。

lines.en: All this gash will do is stain what’s meant to be a sanctuary. And when blood is spilled on holy ground, divinity must be questioned.
lines.zh: 这道伤口做不了别的，只会玷污本该是避难所的地方。而当血洒在圣地之上，神性就必须被质疑。

lines.en: Was this ever safe at all? Or did having a place to call her own do naught but grant her the opportunity to look on in awe as she burns it to the ground?
lines.zh: 这里真的安全过吗？还是说，拥有一个属于自己的地方，只不过给了她一个机会，让她能敬畏地看着自己把它烧成平地？

lines.en: : So...now that we know she’s alive...what do we do?
lines.zh: : 那么……既然我们知道她还活着……我们该怎么办？

lines.en: : We wake her up and tell her to get her shit together, that’s what.
lines.zh: : 我们叫醒她，让她振作起来，就这样。

lines.en: : Mmfgh.....blch ch......
lines.zh: : Mmfgh…………blch ch…………

lines.en: : But-
lines.zh: : 可是——

lines.en: scene yukicheckup7
: Yuki. Come on. It’s time to wake up.
lines.zh: : Yuki。拜托。该起床了。

lines.en: : Mmlgh......mlphph......blch.....
lines.zh: : Mmlgh…………mlphph…………blch…………

lines.en: : Is it even okay to wake people up when they’re like this? Shouldn’t we maybe let her...sleep it off?
lines.zh: : 人醉成这样，叫醒真的好吗？我们是不是该让她……睡一觉把酒醒掉？

lines.en: : Then what? Let her wake up tomorrow and wash away the aftertaste of old beer with {i}new{/i} beer? You’re being too easy on her.
lines.zh: : 然后呢？让她明天醒来，用{i}新{/i}啤酒冲掉陈啤酒的余味？你对她太宽容了。

lines.en: : Sorry, I just...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我只是……

lines.en: : This isn’t something I’m used to dealing with.
lines.zh: : 这种事我不太习惯处理。

lines.en: : Then leave it to the professionals. I come from a long line of people who drink more than they probably should.
lines.zh: : 那就交给专业人士。我祖上好几代人喝得都比该喝的多。

lines.en: : Yuki, rise and shine. I {i}will{/i} shake you if I have to.
lines.zh: : Yuki，起床了。有必要的话我{i}就{/i}摇你了。

lines.en: : Mmnh......go away......
lines.zh: : Mmnh…………走开…………

lines.en: : Sensei, could you get the lights?
lines.zh: : 老师，麻烦你开下灯？

lines.en: : Noooooo....leave ‘em off.....I’m tryin’ to......fuckin’ sleep......just come back......tomorrow.......
lines.zh: : 不——要……关着……我正想……他妈的睡觉呢……你们明天……再来吧…………

lines.en: scene yukicheckup8
: Sure, Yuki! I’ll {i}gladly{/i} come {i}all the way{/i} to your apartment {i}tomorrow{/i} too because you’re {i}tired{/i} right now! You got it!
lines.zh: : 好啊，Yuki！就因为你现在{i}累{/i}了，我{i}明天{/i}也{i}高高兴兴{/i}{i}大老远{/i}跑来你家！没问题！

lines.en: : Sara-
lines.zh: : Sara——

lines.en: : Sensei, lights!
lines.zh: : 老师，开灯！

lines.en: scene yukicheckup9
I do as I’m told since that’s all I’m good for once you take away what I hide between my legs. And all that I have room for there right now is my tail.
lines.zh: 我照做了，因为一旦拿掉我藏在两腿之间的东西，我就只会听话了。而那儿现在唯一放得下的，就是我的尾巴。

lines.en: : Chop chop! Up and at ‘em! Time to rejoin us in the real world.
lines.zh: : 快点快点！起来起来！该回到现实世界里来了。

lines.en: Sara claps her hands and shakes Yuki by her shoulder.
lines.zh: Sara 拍了拍手，抓着 Yuki 的肩膀晃她。

lines.en: There’s a brief window where I can see her face- covered in drool from sleeping in a puddle of it. But she wipes it away and turns to face the couch once her lagging brain manages to get the message of the light.
lines.zh: 有一瞬间我能看到她的脸——因为睡在一滩口水里而糊满了口水。但她把口水擦掉，等迟钝的大脑终于处理完灯光传递的信息，便转过身面向沙发。

lines.en: As she shields her eyes, I once again tell myself that we’re in the wrong here.
lines.zh: 她挡着眼睛的时候，我再一次告诉自己，错的是我们。

lines.en: But I told myself I was in the right when I let a girl not even half her age abuse unprescribed medication for months, so I guess that Sara’s probably right this time.
lines.zh: 可当初我让一个还不到她一半年纪的女孩滥服处方外的药、一吃就是好几个月时，我也告诉自己我是对的——所以这次大概 Sara 是对的。

lines.en: I guess I {i}should{/i} leave this to the experts. I mean...it’s not like I can just {i}fuck{/i} someone’s addiction away.
lines.zh: 我想这事儿{i}该{/i}交给专家。我是说……我又不能靠做爱把一个人的毒瘾{i}操{/i}没。

lines.en: But imagine how much I’d be able to accomplish if I {i}could.{/i}
lines.zh: 不过想象一下，要是我真{i}能做到{/i}，那得成就多少事。

lines.en: : Fine! Jesus...I’m up, I’m up...
lines.zh: : 行吧！天啊……我起来了，起来了……

lines.en: scene yukicheckup10
: The fuck are you two doin’ here?...Don’t feel like hangin’ out tonight...
lines.zh: : 你俩他妈的在这儿干嘛？……我今晚不想跟人待着……

lines.en: : I’m the one who should be asking {i}you{/i} that. You skipped work {i}again{/i} tonight and Sana’s stuck working on her own for the third time this week.
lines.zh: : 该问这话的是我。你今晚{i}又{/i}旷工了，Sana 这周已经是第三次一个人扛全场了。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup11
: Oh, shit...I was on the schedule?
lines.zh: : 哦，操……今天排的是我的班？

lines.en: : Yes...I texted you about it like ten times today.
lines.zh: : 对……我今天给你发了大概十条短信。

lines.en: : I must’ve...forgot again or some shit. Sorry, Sara. I’ll...go get...dressed now...
lines.zh: : 我肯定……又忘了还是怎么的。抱歉，Sara。我……现在就去……换衣服……

lines.en: : I swear it won't happen again...I-
lines.zh: : 我保证不会再有下次了……我——

lines.en: : Yuki, no. I don’t want you coming to work when you’re like {i}this.{/i}
lines.zh: : Yuki，别。我不想让你{i}这副样子{/i}来上班。

lines.en: : Like what? I’m just tired...You guys woke me up in the middle of the fuckin’ night. The hell you want from me?
lines.zh: : 什么样子？我只是累了……你们俩深更半夜把我叫醒。你们到底想怎样？

lines.en: : Honesty would be a good place to start. Maybe an admission that you’re hammered out of your mind and not just “tired.”
lines.zh: : 从诚实开始就挺好。也许你该承认自己已经醉得神志不清了，而不只是「累了」。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup12
: Okay. Fine. So I got drunk. Who gives a shit? You drink at the bar all the fuckin’ time. What difference does it make if I do it too?
lines.zh: : 行。好吧。那我就是喝醉了。谁他妈在乎？你不是也天天在酒吧喝吗。我也喝有什么两样？

lines.en: : The difference is Sara’s never missed a shift.
lines.zh: : 区别在于，Sara 从来没有旷过班。

lines.en: : Sara lives at the fuckin’ bar. All she’s gotta do is walk downstairs. It ain’t hard.
lines.zh: : Sara 就他妈住在酒吧里。她只要走下楼就行了。这又不难。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup9
: Sara was really worried about you. We both were. You should at least thank her for coming all the way over here to check on you.
lines.zh: : Sara 真的很担心你。我们俩都很担心。你至少该谢谢她大老远跑过来看看你。

lines.en: : We thought you might be dead, Yuki...
lines.zh: : 我们以为你可能死了，Yuki……

lines.en: scene yukicheckup13
: {i}Dead?{/i} Gimme a fuckin’ break. If I ain’t been killed by all the shit I’ve already been through, ain’t nothin’ killin’ me now.
lines.zh: : {i}死{/i}？得了吧。我经历过那么多破事都没死，现在也没什么能弄死我。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} might if you quit dancing around the fact that you’re an addict and could have relapsed for all we knew.
lines.zh: : 要是你别再绕着「你是个瘾君子」这件事兜圈子，{i}我{/i}也许真会弄死你——毕竟我们当时还以为你可能复吸了。

lines.en: : Well, what’s the fuckin’ point in makin’ sure if I’m alive if you’re just gonna kill me yourself?
lines.zh: : 那你们先确认我没死，转头又要亲手弄死我，这他妈图什么？

lines.en: scene yukicheckup14
: Yuki! I’m being serious! You can’t be acting this way! You have a job and a {i}daughter{/i} again! Are you {i}trying{/i} to throw that away?!
lines.zh: : Yuki！我是认真的！你不能这样！你现在又有工作、又有{i}女儿{/i}了！你是{i}想{/i}把这一切都扔掉吗？！

lines.en: : Jesus. Can you be serious without yelling? Fuckin’ head hurts and this shit ain’t helping.
lines.zh: : 天啊。你能不能别吼着认真？我他妈头疼得要死，你们这样一点用都没有。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup15
: Are you using again? Just because I don’t see anything lying around doesn’t mean you’re innocent. Show me your arms. Now.
lines.zh: : 你是不是又在嗑了？我没看到什么东西散在地上，不代表你就是清白的。把胳膊给我看。现在。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup16
: Jesus. Here. Look at ‘em. I ain’t done shit.
lines.zh: : 天啊。给。看吧。我什么都没干。

lines.en: : No, you just haven’t been {i}caught.{/i} And your arms might pass the test, but that {i}still{/i} doesn’t mean anything.
lines.zh: : 不，你只是还没{i}被抓到{/i}。你的胳膊也许能通过检查，但那{i}依然{/i}说明不了什么。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup17
: You bring a fuckin’ cup for me to piss in too? The fuck do you want, huh?
lines.zh: : 你他妈还带了个杯子让我尿进去？你到底想怎样，嗯？

lines.en: : I want you to get your shit together. It’s one thing missing a shift or two. But doing it multiple times a week because you’re passed out in your apartment? You’re supposed to be better than that, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 我想让你振作起来。缺一两班是一回事。可一星期好几次都因为你醉死在公寓里而缺勤？你不该是这样的人，Yuki。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup18
: Me? {i}Better{/i} than something? You forget who you’re fuckin’ talkin’ to, Sara?
lines.zh: : 我？{i}不该{/i}是这样的人？Sara，你忘了你他妈在跟谁说话吗？

lines.en: : I’m a fuckin’ deadbeat, dude. All I do now is just work...or ride my bike and drink when I {i}ain’t{/i} workin’.
lines.zh: : 我就是个他妈的废物，老兄。我现在只会干活……{i}不{/i}干活的时候就骑我的车、喝酒。

lines.en: : Hell, sometimes I do both of those at the same time. So you should be happy I ain’t doin’ fuckin’ doughnuts in your damn bar, okay?
lines.zh: : 操，有时候我还一边骑车一边喝。所以你该庆幸我没在你那破酒吧里玩他妈的甩尾，懂吗？

lines.en: : You wanna fire me? Fire me. I’ll just fuckin’ melt into the couch and bum money off my ex or some shit. Who even gives a fuck anymore?
lines.zh: : 你想开除我？开啊。我就他妈烂在沙发上，跟我前夫要点钱什么的。谁他妈还在乎啊？

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} do. And the fact that you’re willing to bum money off of your ex after all of the things you’ve told me about him explains {i}everything,{/i} Yuki.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}在乎。而你在跟我说了那么多关于他的事之后，还愿意去跟前夫要钱，这一点就说明了{i}一切{/i}，Yuki。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup19
: What happened?...
lines.zh: : 发生什么了？……

lines.en: : Nothin’.
lines.zh: : 没什么。

lines.en: : I just fuckin’ suck.
lines.zh: : 我就是他妈的废物。

lines.en: : This is what I do.
lines.zh: : 我就是这样的人。

lines.en: : Y’all just ain’t been around long enough to see it happen yet.
lines.zh: : 你们只是认识我不够久，还没见过而已。

lines.en: : How can we help?
lines.zh: : 我们要怎么帮你？

lines.en: : I mean...{i}not{/i} gettin’ fired would be pretty cool. Ain’t like I’m {i}tryin’{/i} to skip work. That’s just how it’s been goin’ lately.
lines.zh: : 我说……{i}别{/i}被开除就挺好的。我又不是{i}故意{/i}旷工。最近就是这么个状况。

lines.en: : Yuki- you {i}can’t{/i} keep doing that, though. I’m your friend and your boss, not your sponsor. I can’t babysit you every day and make sure you haven’t drunk yourself to death.
lines.zh: : Yuki——可你{i}不能{/i}一直这样。我是你的朋友，也是你的老板，不是你的戒断担保人。我不可能天天看着你，确认你没把自己喝死。

lines.en: : I ain’t sure what to tell you other than you should’a seen this coming, Sara. Shit happens when you hire junkies.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还能说什么，Sara，只能说你早该料到会这样。雇瘾君子就是会有这种破事。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup20
: Are you trying to say this is somehow {i}her{/i} fault?
lines.zh: : 你是想说，这某种程度上是{i}她的{/i}错？

lines.en: : Oh, hey. Been so quiet I forgot you were here.
lines.zh: : 哦，嗨。你一直这么安静，我都忘了你还在。

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ve been a little busy trying to wrap my head around how you’re so nonchalant about this while two of the only people who actually {i}care{/i} about you are trying to help.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我一直在忙着想明白，在场唯二真正{i}在乎{/i}你的人正想帮你，你怎么还能这么不当回事。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup21
: What fuckin’ reason would you two have to possibly care? Ain’t like your lives would be any worse without me. Hell, they’d probably be {i}better{/i} since you wouldn’t have to do shit like this.
lines.zh: : 你们俩到底有什么他妈的理由要在乎？没有我，你们的日子也不会更差。操，说不定还会{i}更好{/i}，毕竟你们就不用干这种破事了。

lines.en: : You don’t need a reason to care about someone, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 在乎一个人是不需要理由的，Yuki。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup22
: I met you. I like you. And I want to keep seeing you, so I’m {i}okay{/i} with looking after you when I need to. But {i}you{/i} need to put in effort too.
lines.zh: : 我认识了你。我喜欢你。而且我想继续见到你，所以我{i}愿意{/i}在必要的时候照顾你。但{i}你{/i}也要自己努力。

lines.en: : You can’t just return to your old ways whenever you feel like it. Not when you’ve come {i}so{/i} far. You’re finally living a somewhat normal life. Why ruin it?
lines.zh: : 你不能想什么时候就什么时候回到老路上去。尤其在你已经走了{i}这么{/i}远之后。你终于过上了还算正常的生活。为什么要毁掉它？

lines.en: : I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup23
: Maybe I don’t like “normal?”
lines.zh: : 也许我就是不喜欢「正常」？

lines.en: : All my life, I’ve been runnin’ from {i}somethin’.{/i} Home. Cops. Yakuza. Yumi. Drugs. There’s always some fuckin’...{i}evil.{/i} Even if that evil ain’t {i}actually{/i} evil, you know?
lines.zh: : 我这辈子一直在躲{i}什么东西{/i}。家。警察。黑帮。Yumi。毒品。总有某种……他妈的{i}邪恶{/i}。哪怕那种邪恶{i}其实{/i}并不邪恶，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Just somethin’ to fight back against or avoid and...
lines.zh: : 就是某个可以反抗或者躲开的东西，然后……

lines.en: : Heh.
: For the first time ever, I ain’t got that.
lines.zh: : 有生以来第一次，我什么都没有了。

lines.en: : Went from there always bein’ something in the background I need to look out for to...my own couch. Buyin’ TV dinners for two people instead of one. {i}Money.{/i}
lines.zh: : 从过去背景里总有某个我需要提防的东西，变成了……我自己的沙发。买两人份的电视晚餐，而不是一人份。还有{i}钱{/i}。

lines.en: : I don’t fuckin’ deserve any of that. I’ve seen girls way better than me — ones who ain’t ever did anythin’ wrong get fuckin’ killed by the same shit {i}I{/i} used for years. Why {i}them?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那些我他妈一样都不配拥有。我见过比我好得多的女孩——从没做过任何错事的那种——被{i}我{/i}用过那么多年的同一种东西活活弄死。凭什么是{i}她们{/i}？

lines.en: : That’s how I know there ain’t no god. Fucker’s fine with me doin’ everythin’ in my power to burn this world to the ground while lettin’ the ones who could do some good rot. I don’t get it.
lines.zh: : 所以我才知道根本没有上帝。那混蛋眼看着我尽我所能把这个世界烧成灰烬也无所谓，却让那些本可以做好事的人烂掉。我不明白。

lines.en: : Neither do I, Yuki...but {i}this{/i} isn’t the answer.
lines.zh: : 我也不明白，Yuki……但{i}这{/i}不是答案。

lines.en: scene yukicheckup24
: What {i}is{/i} then, Sara?...
lines.zh: : 那什么{i}才是{/i}答案，Sara？……

lines.en: : How’s a fuck-up like me ever supposed to live with herself?...
lines.zh: : 像我这样的废物，到底该怎么跟自己相处下去？……

lines.en: : By...doing all you can with what time you have left. Life isn’t over until it’s over, Yuki.
lines.zh: : 靠……用你剩下的时间尽力去做。只要还没结束，人生就没结束，Yuki。

lines.en: : Maybe...But I ain’t got enough time left to do {i}shit.{/i}
lines.zh: : 也许吧……可我剩下的时间，{i}什么都{/i}做不了。

lines.en: : You don’t know that...
lines.zh: : 这你并不知道……

lines.en: : Neither do you. Just how life works.
lines.zh: : 你也不知道。人生就是这样。

lines.en: : Or doesn’t...
lines.zh: : 或者不是这样……

lines.en: : Get it?
lines.zh: : 懂了吗？

lines.en: scene yukicheckup25
: You’re seriously going to make jokes right now? {i}That’s{/i} how you want to handle this?
lines.zh: : 你认真的吗，这种时候还要开玩笑？你就打算{i}这么{/i}处理？

lines.en: : Why you askin’? You got a better idea?
lines.zh: : 那你问这个干嘛？你有更好的主意？

lines.en: : Yeah. Clean up your fucking act and stop shitting all over the people who care about you.
lines.zh: : 有。把你他妈的德行收拾干净，别再往在乎你的人身上泼屎了。

lines.en: : You miss one more shift, you’re done. Got it?
lines.zh: : 你再缺一次班，就完了。听懂了吗？

lines.en: : Sir, yes, sir...
lines.zh: : 遵命，长官……

lines.en: scene black
: Goodnight.
lines.zh: : 晚安。

lines.en: : Wait, you’re leaving?
lines.zh: : 等等，你要走了？

lines.en: : Yeah...I need to go cool down.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我得去冷静一下。

lines.en: : If I hear one more word from her, I’m going to slap her so hard she’ll forget she’s even shit faced.
lines.zh: : 要是再听她说一个字，我就扇她一巴掌，扇到她忘了自己醉成什么样。

lines.en: : Damn, yo. You should’ve just started with that. Would save me from a hangover in the morning.
lines.zh: : 啧，喂。你早这么说不就完了。还能省得我明天宿醉。

lines.en: : You fucking- UGH!
lines.zh: : 你这个混——呃啊！

lines.en: : You have {i}no{/i} idea what this does to other people, do you?! How can you be so selfish?! How can-
lines.zh: : 你{i}根本不{/i}知道这会给别人造成什么影响，是吧？！你怎么能这么自私？！你怎么能——

lines.en: : Sara...yelling isn't going to help.
lines.zh: : Sara……吼是没有用的。

lines.en: : I know that! But watching her {i}ruin{/i} everything she worked so hard for is just- UGH!
lines.zh: : 我知道！可看着她把自己拼命换来的一切都{i}毁掉{/i}，这实在——呃啊！

lines.en: : Goodnight for real this time!
lines.zh: : 这次是真的晚安了！

lines.en: scene yukicheckup9
Sara slams the door behind her and Yuki slumps back on the couch.
lines.zh: Sara 摔门而去，Yuki 又瘫回沙发上。

lines.en: To be honest, I wish I followed her.
lines.zh: 说实话，我真希望我跟着她走了。

lines.en: Not just because I’d feel more comfortable knowing she has company on the way home-
lines.zh: 不只是因为知道她回家路上有人陪，我会更安心——

lines.en: Not just because I know she can probably relate to this on some level-
lines.zh: 不只是因为我知道她大概在某种程度上能体会这种事——

lines.en: Not just because I want to see the various expressions on her face — the various sobs and moans and cries she will make as she relives a prior Hell-
lines.zh: 不只是因为我想看到她脸上各种各样的表情——她重温从前那场地狱时会发出的各种啜泣、呻吟与哭喊——

lines.en: But because I’m mad too.
lines.zh: 而是因为我也很生气。

lines.en: And I know I shouldn’t be as someone who also struggles to live with himself.
lines.zh: 而我明明也是个难以与自己相处的人，我知道我不该生气。

lines.en: But I feel sick each time I look in the mirror — and my reflection isn’t far from here.
lines.zh: 可每次照镜子我都觉得恶心——而我的倒影离这儿并不远。

lines.en: : Do you feel good about yourself right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在自我感觉良好吗？

lines.en: : Man, I haven’t felt good about myself in almost forty years. Were you even fuckin’ listening to any of that?
lines.zh: : 老兄，我都快四十年没对自己感觉良好过了。你他妈到底有没有在听啊？

lines.en: : Sara really cares about you, Yuki. And I get that burning bridges is “your thing” and all, but this is one you {i}really{/i} want to leave intact.
lines.zh: : Sara 是真的在乎你，Yuki。我知道烧桥是你的「拿手好戏」，但这一座桥你{i}真的{/i}得留着。
